command_help.stdout:
usage: cache_h.py [-h] --config CONFIG --run-id RUN_ID [--device DEVICE]

FP32 H evaluation caches with live, fail-closed five-pair authorization. Each
of the seven accepted H evaluation tables has its own canonical cache at
artifact_root/features/H/<run_id>/<role>. Features and ORIGINAL two-output
head remain FP32; scoring promotes both head rows before subtraction. No
source CAL AUC is calculated here. Every verification freshly hashes processed
PNG bytes and decoded RGB, even if stat metadata is absent or unchanged.
Source-video bytes are covered by accepted freeze evidence; the default freeze
validator rechecks metadata, not video bytes. This module does not claim a
fresh source-video integrity scan. Committed chunk markers follow atomic array
writes. Unmarked partial arrays are overwritten on resume; committed
corruption is rejected. A completed cache is verified and reused without
constructing an encoder. CUDA export uses the original trainer's lifetime GPU
ownership and fresh H/D-priority boundaries.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG
  --run-id RUN_ID
  --device DEVICE
